limitations: This review evaluates assembled geometry, not physical printed fit, shrinkage, adhesive access/strength or handling strength.
Zero designed joint clearance has no fit tolerance, pin, socket or mechanical registration. Dry fitting/finishing is required by manufacturing instructions and remains untested.
Raw float32 STL normalization and literal assembly offsets create sub-micrometre gaps/overlaps; all measured signed distances and volumes remain in report.
Face-area method covers axis-aligned planar mating faces; does not assert arbitrary curved/non-axis contact detection. Full solid Boolean covers all faces.
